extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and density tolerance from a workflow config dictionary
filter_single_dataset: filter and deduplicate crystal structures in a single parquet dataset by energy, density, and connectivity
filter_all_datasets: orchestrate parallel SLURM jobs to filter and deduplicate structures across multiple parquet datasets
review_filter_workflow: review the post-relaxation filtering workflow that applies energy cutoff, density cutoff, connectivity checks, and deduplication
refactor_deduplication_params: refactor the filter_and_deduplicate_structures_single function to adjust lattice tolerance, site tolerance, or angle tolerance parameters
